name: dev.workers.revenue-agent-jw.agent-utils-x402-production/agent-utils
title: Agent Utils (x402)
description: Public records, OSV, PII redact, web reader, stablecoin freeze check for agents. x402 USDC

tools.name: recall_check
tools.description: Product and vehicle recall lookup across US agencies in one call: NHTSA (cars, by VIN or make/model/year), CPSC (consumer products, by UPC or product name) and FDA enforcement reports (food, drugs, medical devices). Useful for safety checks before buying, selling or using a product or vehicle. Returns normalized recalls (number, date, hazard/reason, remedy, link), newest first, plus anyRecall. Errors: 400 JSON {error} for invalid input. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/recalls/check.

vin.description: 17-char VIN; recalls for its decoded make/model/year

q.description: product name or keywords, 3-100 chars, e.g. 'stroller' or 'peanut butter'

tools.name: sanctions_address_check
tools.description: OFAC sanctions screening for crypto wallet addresses: exact match against every digital currency address on the U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN list (BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, TRX, SOL, LTC, XMR and more). Useful for compliance and AML checks before paying a counterparty or an x402 payTo. Up to 20 comma-separated addresses; returns sanctioned true/false, SDN name, programs, official link and list freshness. Errors: 400 JSON {error} for invalid input. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/sanctions/address.

address.description: crypto address, or up to 20 comma-separated

tools.name: sanctions_name_screen
tools.description: OFAC sanctions name screening for KYC/AML/KYB: fuzzy match a person, company, vessel or aircraft name against every primary name and alias on the U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN and Consolidated (non-SDN) lists. Accent, word-order and suffix tolerant. Up to 10 names (names=A|B). Returns verdict, score, list, programs, DOB, countries, official link. 400 invalid input. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/sanctions/name.

name.description: person, company, vessel or aircraft name (any word order, e.g. 'Maduro Moros, Nicolas')

names.description: alternative to name: up to 10 names separated by |

type.description: restrict to one entry type, default any

country.description: optional country (e.g. Cuba) to flag countryMatch on hits

birthYear.description: optional 4-digit birth year to flag birthYearMatch on hits

tools.name: climate_day
tools.description: Daily high and low temperature for a US weather station from NWS: running provisional high/low over the station's climate day (midnight-midnight local standard time) and the official NWS Daily Climate Report (CLI) high/low once issued, flagged preliminary or final. Useful for temperature settlement, weather prediction markets and climate records. Optional temperature buckets (width/offset or explicit edges). Errors: 400 JSON {error} for invalid input. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/weather/climate-day.

station.description: NWS/ICAO station id, e.g. KNYC, KMDW, KLAX

date.description: climate date (LST), default today; up to ~6 days back

edges.description: comma-separated increasing bucket edges; overrides width/offset

cli.description: override CLI location code (default: station without leading K)

tools.name: us_weather
tools.description: US weather forecast, current conditions and severe-weather alerts for a latitude/longitude from the National Weather Service (NWS) in one call. Useful when an agent needs local temperature, a forecast or active alerts for a US location. Returns the latest station observation, next 12 hourly periods, 6-period forecast and active alerts as normalized JSON. Errors: 400 JSON {error} for invalid input. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/weather/us.

tools.name: sec_filings
tools.description: SEC EDGAR company filings and financials for a stock ticker or CIK in one call: latest 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and other forms with dates, accession numbers, primary document and index URLs, plus optional XBRL facts (revenue, net income, shares outstanding). Useful for company research, due diligence and earnings monitoring. Errors: 400 JSON {error} for an unknown ticker; 503 while the shared SEC rate limit is busy. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/sec/filings.

tools.name: injection_scan
tools.description: Prompt-injection detection for untrusted text (web pages, emails, documents, tool output) before it reaches an LLM; a guardrail for agent pipelines. Flags instruction overrides, role spoofing, secret/system-prompt exfiltration, image beacons, tool-call markup, hidden Unicode, hidden HTML and base64 payloads. Returns a 0-100 risk score, risk level and matched rules. Deterministic rules, no LLM. JSON body {text}, max 32 KB. Errors: 400 missing text, 413 too large. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: POST /v1/text/injection-scan.

tools.name: us_business_days
tools.description: US business days calculator: counts working days between two dates (inclusive), excluding weekends and observed US federal holidays per 5 U.S.C. 6103 and OPM rules. Useful for deadlines, SLAs, shipping and payment due dates. Returns the count and lists the holidays skipped. Errors: 400 JSON {error} for invalid input. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/calendar/us-business-days.

tools.name: x402_check
tools.description: x402 endpoint validator and payment-readiness checker, useful for sellers debugging a paywall or buyers vetting an endpoint before paying. Fetches the URL unpaid, decodes the 402 challenge and grades network, USDC asset, payTo, price vs facilitator fees, EIP-712 domain, CORS and Bazaar metadata. Returns a 0-100 score and a fix list. Never pays the target. Errors: 400 JSON {error} for invalid input. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/x402/check.

url.description: https URL of the x402-protected endpoint

tools.name: caller_avoidance_score
tools.description: Caller Avoidance Score (callers-avoid-0.1, outcome-only; honesty deferred): toxicity / avoid grade for a Crypto Twitter handle from public-call follower sim (post+5m, fees). Returns avoid_score 0-100, band, components with receipts (sim_mean, sim_win_rate, rug_rate, hit_2x_24h + Wilson CI), verdict (copy_buy_loses|insufficient_sample|mixed), and public post id links — not full post text. Free when n_scored<4 via GET /v0/callers/score. Not financial advice. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/callers/score.

tools.name: federal_register_search
tools.description: Federal Register search for US rules, proposed rules, notices and presidential documents by keyword, agency, type and publication date, or one document by number. Useful for regulatory monitoring and compliance research. Returns title, type, action, abstract, agencies, effective and comment-close dates, docket IDs, RINs, CFR parts, citation and official HTML/PDF links, with source URL and retrievedAt. Errors: 400 invalid input, 404 unknown document. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/federal-register/search.

tools.name: clinical_trials_search
tools.description: ClinicalTrials.gov study search (official v2 API) by condition, intervention/drug, sponsor, location, keyword, recruitment status and phase. Useful for trial finding, pipeline and competitive research. Returns total count, NCT IDs, titles, status, phases, conditions, interventions, sponsor, enrollment, key dates, has-results flag and study links, with paging token, source URL and retrievedAt. Errors: 400 invalid input. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/clinical-trials/search.

status.description: comma-separated: RECRUITING, NOT_YET_RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, ...

tools.name: clinical_trial_study
tools.description: ClinicalTrials.gov study lookup by NCT ID (official v2 API). Useful when an agent needs the facts of one trial. Returns titles, sponsor and collaborators, status and why stopped, key dates, phases, design, enrollment, conditions, interventions, primary outcomes, eligibility (ages, sex, criteria text), summary, site count, countries and up to 25 sites, plus results link, source URL and retrievedAt. Errors: 400 bad NCT ID, 404 not found. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/clinical-trials/study.

tools.name: fda_drug_label
tools.description: FDA drug label (package insert, SPL) lookup via openFDA by brand or generic name, NDC or set ID; prefers the original packager's latest label. Useful for indications, dosing, boxed warnings, contraindications, interactions and adverse reactions. Returns label metadata (brand, generic, manufacturer, application number, NDCs, RxCUI) and selected sections trimmed to max_chars, plus DailyMed link and retrievedAt. Errors: 400 invalid input, 404 no label. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/fda/drug-label.

tools.name: fda_adverse_events
tools.description: FDA adverse event report counts (FAERS via openFDA) for a drug by generic or brand name, optionally filtered by reaction, date range or serious reports only. Useful for drug safety signal checks and pharmacovigilance research. Returns total, serious, non-serious and death report counts and the top reported reactions, with source URL, FDA data date and retrievedAt. Reports do not prove causation. Errors: 400 invalid input. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/fda/adverse-events.

tools.name: fda_ndc_lookup
tools.description: FDA National Drug Code (NDC) directory lookup via openFDA by product or package NDC (dashed, or 10/11-digit billing format) or by drug name. Useful for pharmacy, claims and inventory data. Returns product NDC, brand and generic names, labeler, dosage form, route, active ingredients and strengths, marketing category and dates, application number, DEA schedule and packages, with DailyMed link and retrievedAt. Errors: 400 invalid input, 404 no match. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/fda/ndc.

tools.name: sec_8k_filings
tools.description: SEC 8-K current reports from EDGAR: one company's 8-Ks by ticker or CIK, or the latest 8-Ks market-wide, optionally by item code (2.02 earnings, 5.02 officer changes, 1.01 agreements) or full-text phrase. Useful for event monitoring and research. Returns company, CIK, tickers, filing date, accession number, decoded items and document and index URLs, with retrievedAt. Errors: 400 invalid input, 503 SEC rate limit busy. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/sec/8k.

tools.name: sec_13f_holdings
tools.description: SEC 13F-HR institutional holdings for a filer by CIK or ticker (latest quarter or a given accession), parsed from the EDGAR information table. Useful for tracking what funds like Berkshire Hathaway hold. Returns period, holdings ranked by value with issuer, CUSIP, class, shares, put/call and portfolio percent, totals checked against the cover page, recent 13F filings and source URLs. Tables over 1.5 MB return 422. Errors: 400, 404 no 13F. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/sec/13f.

ticker.description: alternative to cik when the filer is listed

tools.name: email_auth_audit
tools.description: Email authentication DNS audit for a domain or email address: SPF with recursive 10-lookup count and all qualifier, DMARC policy, pct and report addresses, DKIM selector probe, MTA-STS with policy file, TLS-RPT, BIMI and MX. Useful for deliverability checks, Google/Yahoo bulk-sender readiness and spoofing risk. Returns grade A-F, score, spoofable flag, parsed records and plain-language issues. Errors: 400 invalid domain, 404 NXDOMAIN. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/dns/email-auth.

domain.description: domain or email address, e.g. paypal.com

selectors.description: optional comma-separated DKIM selectors to probe (max 12); default probes 12 common ones

tools.name: osv_package_vulns
tools.description: Open-source package vulnerability check via OSV.dev for npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, Maven, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist and more, by ecosystem+name+version, purl, or up to 10 purls. Useful before installing or upgrading a dependency. Returns vulnerable flag, count, CVE/GHSA aliases, CVSS score and severity, fixed versions and a verified upgradeTo version. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 OSV unavailable. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/osv/package.

ecosystem.description: OSV ecosystem, case-insensitive: npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, Maven, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist, Hex, Pub, Debian:12 ...

name.description: package name; Maven uses groupId:artifactId, Go uses the module path

version.description: optional exact version; omit for all known advisories

limit.description: max vulns returned per package, default 50

tools.name: text_pii_redact
tools.description: Deterministic PII detect-and-redact for untrusted text (tickets, chat logs, LLM prompts) before storage or model input. Finds email, phone, US SSN, credit card (Luhn), IP, IBAN (mod-97), US ABA routing, and secret prefixes (sk-, ghp_, AKIA…). Checksum-validated; no LLM/NER. Returns findings with offsets, placeholders, redacted copy and countsByType. Optional types= filter. POST JSON {text} max 32 KB (GET ?text= max 2,000). Errors: 400 bad input. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: POST /v1/text/pii-redact.

tools.name: solana_pre_promo
tools.description: Pre-promo tape lookup for a Solana token when we hold a locked [-60m,0] window around its DexScreener paid-promo timestamp (specialty covered shelf). Returns raw aggregates: net buy USD, unique buyers, largest buyer share, and the same vs a matched-null mean from other covered tokens. Uncovered token: 404 with coverage:false, never fabricated. Free probe: GET /v0/solana/pre-promo-coverage. Not financial advice. PAID: $0.01 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/solana/pre-promo.

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Web page reader for agents: fetch one public URL and get clean Markdown or text of the main content plus title, description, canonical, language, dates, headings and absolute links. Strips nav, scripts and cookie banners; follows redirects; handles JSON/text. Honors robots.txt and never bypasses logins or bot blocks. Errors are not charged: 400 bad URL, 422 robots/404/blocked, 502 unreachable. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/web/read.

links.description: include link list and inline Markdown links, default 1

tools.name: fixture_settle
tools.description: Known-answer x402 payment fixture for auditor and client self-tests. A paid call settles exactly at $0.001 USDC and returns the published known answer plus a signed receipt (payer, amount, tx, server time). Useful to prove a wallet and x402 client work end to end. Failed payments are not charged and return a machine-readable error. Spec: GET /v0/fixture/spec. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/fixture/settle.

tools.name: stablecoin_blacklist_check
tools.description: Can this wallet move USDC or USDT? Live check of issuers' own on-chain blacklists: Circle USDC (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche), EURC (Base, Ethereum), Tether USDT (Ethereum, Tron), plus OFAC SDN exact match. Up to 20 EVM 0x or Tron T addresses. Returns PASS/BLOCK, which token+chain is frozen, block numbers, contracts read. Fails closed: chain unreadable = 502, not charged. 400 invalid address. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/wallet/stablecoin-blacklist.

address.description: one EVM 0x or Tron T address, or up to 20 comma-separated (mixed allowed)

tools.name: gas_estimate
tools.description: Live EVM gas fees on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche: next base fee, slow/standard/fast tips (median of p10/p50/p90 over 20 blocks), EIP-1559 maxFee, and cost of a native or ERC-20 transfer in native and USD (Chainlink), incl. OP-stack L1 data fee. Optional gas=units. Picks cheapest chain. 502 if a chain is unreadable (not charged). PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/gas/estimate.

chains.description: comma list of ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, avalanche (aliases eth, arb, op, matic, avax); default all

gas.description: optional gas units (21000-30000000) to price as a custom transaction

tools.name: world_weather_current
tools.description: Global current weather by city name or lat/lon. Resolves the city (largest match + up to 3 alternatives; optional country or 'City, Region'), returns temp C/F, feels-like, humidity, wind speed/gust/direction, pressure, cloud, precipitation, condition, next 24 hours and 7-day daily summary. Data: MET Norway Locationforecast (CC BY 4.0), GeoNames (CC BY 4.0). Unknown city 400 (free, before payment); upstream down 502, not charged. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/weather/current.

city.description: city name, any case/accents, e.g. 'Paris', 'Portland, ME', 'Sao Paulo' (or use lat+lon)

country.description: optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (or English name) to disambiguate, e.g. US

tools.name: us_federal_holidays
tools.description: FREE. US federal holidays (observed dates) for a year, per 5 U.S.C. 6103. Useful to test the connection before paying.
